text:
alex: PineCart (seed logistics startup) pinging for help. They blew through starter credits in an integration test. Asking for an additional $10k credit to run a 6-week POC (embeddings + chat + reranker) and a short dedicated burst for latency validation. They mentioned potential reserved capacity afterwards but no firm ARR yet.

maria: Do we have POC acceptance criteria + tokens/day? Need to map to startup tiers.

alex: POC goals: 1) embeddings recall >= baseline, 2) streaming chat stability under 2k qps simulated load, 3) <300ms median token latency during peak. Traffic estimate ~120k tokens/week, peaks ~50k tokens/day.

omar: Hosted credits only or are they explicitly requesting Dedicated burst?

alex: They want hosted credits for most tests but a 2-day dedicated burst to reproduce latency claims.

nina: Security: they'll want an IP allowlist sandbox and data retention limits. We can share SOC2 summary and an abbreviated questionnaire. If they insist on VPC/Dedicated, that's a Private pilot (no free credits).

susan: We can stand up a sandbox with ephemeral keys + IP allowlist. Ops can price the 2-day dedicated burst if needed. I can also provide a quick curl example for them.

susan: ```bash
# quick embeddings smoke test
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=redwood-sandbox-abc
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["order routing sample"]}'
```

maria: Startup program standard is $3k for accepted YC/similar. $10k is an exception and needs deal-desk signoff. Any case study or PR ask if we give extra credits?

alex: They offered a short case study and reference call if POC passes. Also helpful: they're integrated into three marketplace partners which could drive usage.

deal-desk: Proposal: approve $6k hosted credit + approval for a paid 2-day Dedicated performance burst quote. Add a conversion incentive: if they convert to a 6-month reserved pool within 90 days, offer 30% credit match (cap $12k) applied to first invoice. Require one-page MOU and standard trial T&Cs.

tom: Finance: credits are recorded as contra-revenue; need billing code and GL mapping. Also we cannot retroactively apply credits after invoice. Ensure AE flags conversion in CRM before invoicing.

legal: We'll review the MOU. Condition: MOU must not amend product T&Cs or SLAs. NDA only if they request.

alex: PineCart requested an 8-week window because they have holiday engineering freeze in week 3. Can we extend trial length?

deal-desk: One-time exception: extend to 8 weeks, conditional on weekly check-ins and usage telemetry shared with us. Update MOU accordingly.

nina: I'll send abbreviated security questionnaire and SOC2 extract. Reminder: any VPC ask escalates to Sales Eng + Ops for Private pricing.

susan: Provisioned sandbox credentials and uploaded to secure share. Will stand up Dedicated burst quote once Delta Ops confirms availability.

maria: Logging exception in pricing tracker: "PineCart trial exception: $6k hosted credit, 2-day Dedicated burst quote, 30% conversion match (cap $12k), 8-week trial with weekly check-ins." CRM note set.

alex: Sending MOU to PineCart now. I'll push for the case study clause and confirm dates for the dedicated burst.

alex: PineCart replied: accepted sandbox and MOU, asked for weekly sync starting next Tuesday.

deal-desk: Approved. Ops, please schedule the Dedicated burst window once AE confirms exact date.

susan: Will coordinate. Thanks team :raised_hands:

maria: Closing loop once MOU signed and first API calls observed. Keep me posted in CRM.

alex: Thanks all — will update thread after kickoff. :rocket:
